title: Reasons for Low Uptake by Couples for Genetic Screening
what_it_is: Reasons for Low Uptake by Couples for Genetic Screening

sections.label: PREDICT pilot programme participation
sections.summary: The PREDICT pilot offers carrier testing to couples at KKH, but fewer than 1,300 showed interest and about 800 have been tested.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The Parenthood Genetic Disease Carrier Test (PREDICT) programme is a pilot project to enhance prenatal screening of carriers of recessive genetic disorders, such as spinal muscular atrophy and Pompe disease.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: While it is offered to almost all couples that KK Women's and Children's Hospital (KKH) is attending to, fewer than 1,300 couples showed interest and wish to participate in the pilot programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Many couples did not complete the mandatory genetic counselling or decide not to proceed after the genetic counselling.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: So, today, about 800 couples have gone through the tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The earlier target set was obviously too ambitious, and we will review both the target and the pilot with KKH and Temasek Foundation, which is funding the programme.

sections.label: Preconception couples and KKH
sections.summary: KKH does not really come into contact with preconception couples because this is a preconception test.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Because this is a preconception test, KKH does not really come into contact with preconception couples.

sections.label: Insurance and PREDICT disease coverage
sections.summary: The speaker suspects insurance concerns and PREDICT covering 80 diseases are reasons, without having done a study.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The second reason, I strongly suspect – we have not done any study about the reasons – is actually insurance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: That if you are tested positive for a genetic condition, couples will ask, "Then what happens to my insurance?" And thirdly, I think PREDICT covers just too many diseases, 80 diseases.

sections.label: Insurance and genetic data underwriting
sections.summary: The speaker says insurance must be addressed, and a new Act is being drafted so genetic data cannot be used for insurance underwriting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Number one, you have to address the issue of insurance – and Members might know, we are in the process of drafting a new Act that will come to this Chamber to approve – so that genetic data cannot be used for insurance underwriting.
